description: Track your Europacific Logistika shipment in seconds. Enter any reference — Position Folder (PF) number, container number, MBL or HBL number, transport order, or booking number — and get the current status, origin → destination route, vessel and carrier, ETA, and the latest milestone, shown in a clear status card. The app is read-only and returns shipment logistics only (no pricing or personal data).
